        """
        UPdate info
        :param user:
        :param email:
        :return:
        """
            user = kwargs.get('user')
            email = kwargs.get('email')
            if user is None:
                return
            if email is None:
                return
            user_id = user.id
            user_email = email.id
            user.email = email
            self.env['res.users'].browse(user_id).write({'email_id': user_email})
